method: op.gg /counters/<role> per-opponent game win rate (op.gg shows no per-matchup lane WR or GD@15 there). Opponents need >= max(30, 25% of the page's median matchup sample) games; ranked by win rate shrunk toward the champion's own games-weighted average matchup WR with 150 pseudo-games; opponents restricted to champions listing that role in champions.json (falls back to all opponents if fewer than 6). wr/games are op.gg's raw values.
